description: §15.11.1 / §15.13.2 (S458) — a component body writing a prop the caller did not bind with `bind:` is E-COMPONENT-PROP-WRITE, once per prop: `n` is passed by value (`n=@v`), and `m` is a bindable prop the caller passed by value (`m=@v`, no `bind:`). The write is never lowered onto the caller's cell. (Interim S458 rounds reused E-ASSIGN-004; the dedicated code is the S458 ruling.)
rationale: §15.11.1: only a prop the caller binds with `bind:` is a write-back channel; §15.13.2: non-`bind` props passed by value are captured once at mount. A body write to any other prop SHALL be E-COMPONENT-PROP-WRITE. Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S458 "your recs on both D1 codes".
